verses.text: Ha heb' yichamtak winakil yaj t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Galaad, haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Maquir yuninal winhaj Manasés, yuninalkan winhaj José, ix ja heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', ix yalan heb' icha tik:

--Hach mamin Moisés, ha Jehová ix halani to ol ha pojek' lum lum t'a ko kal ha honh yinhtilal honh Israel tik hato syala' b'aj ol kik' junjun honh. Ix yalanpaxi to ha jun makan lum t'inhan ol yik' winhaj Zelofehad winh kuktak chamnak, syal yak'ji lum t'a heb' ix yisil winh.

Palta k'inalok ha heb' ix chi' tz'ik'an heb' winh winak t'a junokxo inhtilal heb' ketisraelal, yuj chi' ha lum chi' tzam el lum t'a yol smakb'en kinhtilal tik, axom yek' lum t'a yol smakb'en yinhtilal heb' winh syik' heb' ix chi'.
Slajwi chi', axom yik sk'och yab'ilal yoch k'inh yik tz'el tastak t'a libre, tzam kanxonhej slu'um heb' ix chi' t'a yol smakb'en junxo inhtilal chi', tz'elkan lum t'a yol ko makb'en tik, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová: --Ha heb' winh yinhtilalkan José, yel tas syal heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ha heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad syal yik'an heb' ix yalnhej mach b'aj skan snib'ej, anhej to junnhejokab' yinhtilal heb' winh yet' heb' ix.
Yujto ha junjun makan lum ol yik'kan junjun yinhtilal heb' israel chi', max yal-laj yik'ji'ek' lum yuj junokxo inhtilal heb', palta yowalil junjun inhtilal yet' slu'um ol yik'kani.

Tato ay junok ix ix yalxonhej tas inhtilal ay lum smakb'en ix aykani, yowalil to ha junok winh winak hanheja' yinhtilal ix chi' syik'a'. Icha chi' tz'aj yajek' junjun heb' t'a yol smakb'en ol schakan smam.
Max yal-laj sb'at slu'um junok inhtilal t'a junokxo inhtilal. Junjun yinhtilal heb' israel skannhej yet' smakb'en ol scha'a.

Yuj chi', ha heb' ix yisil winhaj Zelofehad chi': Haton ix Maala, ix Tirsa, ix Hogla, ix Milca yet' ix Noa, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' ix sk'ulan icha ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'. Yuj chi' ha heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' smam heb' ix, ha heb' winh ix yik' heb' ix,
haton heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés yuninal winhaj José. Icha chi' ix aj skannhej smakb'en heb' ix t'a yol smakb'en yinhtilal b'aj kotnak smam heb' ix chi'.
Haton wal juntzanh ley yet' cheknab'il tik ix yak'kan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yuj yalchaj t'a heb' israel, ayik ayek' heb' t'a yak'likal Moab, t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a yichanh Jericó.
